title: Prove generic sales-order report execution and data-scope parity with nonempty isolated SQL data
description: Stage-1 genuine database validation gap. The isolated acceptance database seeds only admin/roles/menus/parameters (SeedData.InitializeAsync) and has zero business rows, so the generic sales-order preview returns zero rows and current-user data scope, filter/date-range, stable sort and paging parity are unproven. Implement a self-contained nonempty business fixture (activated customers, employees, a salesperson data-scope user, non-deleted sales orders) targeting only the dedicated (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance instance and NEWERP_AUTOTEST-prefixed database, guarded before every write, then drive the existing execution path (ReportConfigurationExecutionService -> SalesOrderReportConfigurationDatasetProvider -> DynamicSalesOrderReportQuery) and assert nonempty rows, scoped-customer filtering, date/status/currency filters, stable sort and paging. No production data, arbitrary SQL, secrets/.env changes, permission expansion, schema change or business-flow migration; no SeedData*.cs / SchemaUpgrader.cs edits.
acceptance_criteria: A self-contained integration fixture seeds activated customers, employees, a salesperson data-scope user and non-deleted sales orders into the dedicated (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance / NEWERP_AUTOTEST-prefixed database, asserting target identity before every write and using only process-only test connection settings (never appsettings/.env/production); re-seeding is idempotent and never touches SeedData*.cs or SchemaUpgrader.cs.

Executing the existing sales-order report preview through the generic execution service with nonempty data returns the expected non-deleted rows and columns, and the current-user salesperson data scope limits rows to that user's allowed customers while a privileged user sees all rows; the dataset re-applies menu authorization fail-closed.

Filtering (date range / customer / status / currency), stable sort and safe paging produce the same nonempty results as the offline unit-test parity fixtures; run focused SQL tests, safe Release build/test and scheduler self-test/contracts. Do not claim full stage-1 or real-browser acceptance.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/SeedData.cs:22-75 InitializeAsync seeds only admin role/user/menus/parameters/document-number rules, no SalesOrders/BaseCustomers business rows; src/ERP.IntegrationTests/ReportConfigurationSqlServerTests.cs:313-325 BootstrapAsync runs EnsureCreated+EnsureUpgraded+SeedData+EnsureUpgraded only (no business fixture); .ai/logs/report-platform-http-acceptance-20261004T0847.json records 'preview passed rows: 0'; .ai/logs/report-platform-browser-acceptance-20261004T1000.json records 'zero matched rows' and 'does not prove data-scope or nonempty aggregation parity'; src/ERP.Infrastructure/Reports/DynamicSalesOrderReportQuery.cs:52-57 is the data-scope path that remains unproven with nonempty rows.
